name: wattson-app
description: Wattson — AI 编码用量侦探：菜单栏小窗 + 内嵌看板与 agg-server

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && rm -rf dist/popup dist/wizard && cp -R src/popup dist/popup && cp -R src/wizard dist/wizard
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run prepare-stage && electron-builder --mac dir
scripts.dist:dmg: npm run build && npm run prepare-stage && electron-builder --mac dmg
